title: Glessner's carriage passage loses its floating stone strip
items: A grey stone strip hung across the mouth of Glessner House's carriage passage on Prairie Avenue, between the open oak doors and about a foot above the paving. It was the opening's old sill, left at street level when the passage floor was lowered to the 1963 survey's level. It is gone, and the paving runs straight in under the doors.
